translations.text: Every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out with the army of [?]: you and Aaron shall count them according to their military strength, and they shall be with you.

And the descendants of Joseph, the descendants of Ephraim, according to their families, their clans, and their ancestral households, counted by name, individually: every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out with the army.
Those counted from the tribe of Ephraim totaled forty thousand four hundred.
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
